messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: new to R
parts:
Indeed, DeducerSpatial supports geographic data, and can plot using the Spatial Plot Builder. Wee http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.DeducerSpatial for some (admittedly sparse) documentation. If your R/Deducer are up to date, under the Packages & Data menu you should see a GUI Add Ons -> Spatial option which will install/load the add-on if not already installed. All of the supported functionality is then under the Spatial menu.


best,
Ian
